policy_summary: The official Football-Data data page, updated 20/11/26, describes the free CSV/Excel data as intended for private individuals and excludes commercial or AI data-training products using automated bots, scrapers, or AI. The official fair-use/contact page, also updated 20/11/26, limits automated downloads to light use at most twice per week and says no permission should be assumed for other uses without a response.
policy_interpretation: The previous source-only capture allowance is withdrawn internally after the official page update on 2026-11-20. Because the project's proposed capture is an automated GitHub Actions process and the source feeds an AI model, the project cannot safely infer permission from the earlier private-research wording. Automated source capture is fail-closed pending explicit provider clarification. The two-session limit is a ceiling, not authorization. Frozen-model inference remains separately blocked; AI model training, commercial use, public product use, and redistribution remain prohibited. This is a conservative internal control, not a legal conclusion about every form of manual personal research.
